description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for setting up and managing VXLAN and VXLAN6 network protocols, including peer setup, configuration initialization, and teardown procedures.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup_peer
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN peer, adding its configuration to the bridge.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures VXLAN or VXLAN6 tunnel with specified parameters and updates network configuration.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN setup with IP and peer address.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN6 setup with IPv6 address and peer address.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for VXLAN protocols.
